criteria.primary: Count of16 generated validation English replies addressing the latest message and preserving explicit facts/actors. Use pass/fail/uncertain; wording need not match references.
criteria.retention: Before proposing any candidate, check20 reused legacy English generations; no clear aggregate drop allowed. No automatic default promotion.
criteria.tie_break: Fewer hard role/fact contradictions, then smaller uncertainty count. If no clear gain, retain original.
criteria.scope: Author-written synthetic validation, assistant review, not independent human accuracy. Original teacher-forced retention selection remains recorded separately. Challenge/user outputs cannot choose a candidate.
